description: Source code for generating TypeScript definitions, validators, and protocol metadata for Playwright channels based on protocol YAML. It processes protocol definitions, generates type schemas, and writes output files.

methods.name: raise
methods.description: Throws an error for invalid items during type processing.

methods.name: titleCase
methods.description: Converts a string to title case (first letter uppercase).

methods.name: inlineType
methods.description: Recursively generates TypeScript and schema representations for protocol types.

methods.name: properties
methods.description: Generates TypeScript and schema for object properties.

methods.name: objectType
methods.description: Creates TypeScript and schema for object types.

methods.name: addScheme
methods.description: Adds a schema definition to the validator TypeScript code.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Writes content to a file if it differs from existing content.
